```{r}
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(ggforce)
library(MetBrewer)

# source("../config/config-secret.R")
source("../config/config-secret-local.R")
source("../config/config-graphic.R")
source("../config/config.R")

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), 
                 dbname = dsn_database,
                 host = dsn_hostname, 
                 port = dsn_port,
                 user = dsn_uid, 
                 password = dsn_pwd
)

df_timespan_month <- seq(ymd("1997-01-01"), ymd("2021-06-01"), by = "month") %>% as_tibble()
df_timespan_year <- seq(ymd("1997-01-01"), ymd("2021-06-01"), by = "years") %>% as_tibble()

year_breaks_for_plotting <- df_timespan_year %>% 
  mutate(years = year(value)) %>%
  select(years) %>% pull(.)

df_sites <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT s.crawl_date, s.crawl_timestamp, s.sha1, s.url FROM sites s WHERE s.site ='sueddeutsche' AND s.sphere ='German'")) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(crawl_date),
         month = month(crawl_date),
         simple_date = paste0(year, "-", month, "-01") %>% ymd(.)) %>% 
  mutate(sites_year = n(), .by = "year") # %>% 
  # full_join(., df_timespan_month, by = c("crawl_date" = "value")) # %>% 

sum_sites_year <- df_sites %>% 
  select(year, sites_year) %>% distinct() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(year))

load(file = "../../data/1-parsing/scripts/German/scripts-embedded-db-update.RData")
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig-width: 10

df_sites %>% 
  summarise(counted_sites = n(), .by = c(year)) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = year, y = 0, fill = counted_sites)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks_for_plotting, limits = c(min(year_breaks_for_plotting), max(year_breaks_for_plotting)), expand = c(0, NA), name = "crawl_year") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = met.brewer("Hokusai2", type="continuous"), na.value = "grey90", name = "number of websites available" ) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, NA)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", barwidth = unit(20, "lines"), barheight = unit(.5, "lines"))) +
  theme_b03_base +theme_b03_base_typo_static + theme_b03_heatmap + theme_b03_facets + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
# https://gruppe.spiegel.de/news/pressemitteilungen/detail/quality-channel-startet-vermarktung-der-e-commerce-plattform-marktplatz-auf-spiegel-online
# 2002 -2008
df_site_tracker_vermarktung <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.embedded LIKE '%OAS_RICH%'"))

#https://web.archive.org/web/20050209091245/http://www.websidestory.com/
# 2006-2008
df_site_tracker_websitestory <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.value LIKE '%http://pix.sueddeutsche.de/js/hbx.js%'"))

# hierin hauptsächlich subdomains von sueddeutsche.de, die nicht im Hauptfokus liegen
df_sitestat <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.value LIKE '%sitestat%'"))

# 2008 - 2017
df_sitestat_2 <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.embedded LIKE '%sitestat%'"))

# 2011 - 2012
df_site_tracker_yahoo_script_embedded <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.embedded LIKE '%SDE.advertisement.Yahoo.genericAd%'"))

# 2009 - 2012 (01)
df_site_tracker_yahoo_iframe <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.value LIKE '%eu-pn4.adserver.yahoo.com%'"))


#yahoo tracking: http://d.yimg.com/mi/ywa.js
# 2009 - 2011 (12)
df_site_tracker_yahoo_script <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.value LIKE '%http://d.yimg.com/mi/ywa.js%'"))

# df_site_tracker_yahoo <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.attr LIKE '%http://d.yimg.com/mi/ywa.js%'"))

# 2011 - 2012
df_site_tracker_yahoo_script_embedded <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.embedded LIKE '%SDE.advertisement.Yahoo.genericAd%'"))

# 2011 - 2019 - eigenes Datenobjekt, das im Laufe der Zeit um eine pay-category erweitert wird
df_site_tracker <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.embedded LIKE '%VALITON_WA%'"))

# 2012 - 2021 iqd vermarktung
df_iqd_vermarktung <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.embedded LIKE '%iqd%'"))

# Ausschnitt aus dem oberen tracker-datensatz. Das script-tag, das hier gesucht wird, hat im Laufe der Zeit einen Namen bekommen
df_payed <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.value = 'valitonInit'"))

# 2016 (08) - 2008 (10)
df_adblock_dec <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.tag = 'script' AND t.embedded LIKE '%adblockdetected%'"))

#data-paycategory

# 2019- 2021  nur pay Objekte, keine Info über tracking nach 2019
df_payed_ <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.sha1, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.embedded, s.url FROM tags t INNER JOIN sites s ON t.site = s.sha1 WHERE s.site = 'sueddeutsche' AND t.attr = 'data-paycategory'"))
```

```{r}
exclude <- c("google.de", "google.com", "t.co", "quality-channel.de", "realmedia")
# include_doubleclick <- "doubleclick|google"
include_doubleclick <- "doubleclick"
include_early_adds <- "adserv|adtech|adver|banner|werbung|468x60|468_60|ad250|ad_1|ad6|ads.|p-Ad|ad1.|adbar"

df_doubleclick <- df_findings %>% 
  rename(pattern_ = pattern) %>% 
  filter(!pattern_ %in% exclude) %>% # View()
  filter(str_detect(pattern_, include_doubleclick)) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(crawl_date),
         trace = "doubleclick",
         sorting = 2,
         color = 1) %>% #View()
  select(year, trace, sorting, color) %>% 
  distinct() #%>% 

df_early_ads <- df_findings %>% 
  rename(pattern_ = pattern) %>% 
  filter(!pattern_ %in% exclude) %>% # View()
  filter(!str_detect(pattern_, include_doubleclick)) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(pattern_, include_early_adds))%>% 
  select(crawl_date, pattern_) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(crawl_date),
         trace = "Ad traces in CSS",
         sorting = 1,
         color = 1) %>% #View()
  select(year, trace, sorting, color) %>% 
  distinct() #%>% 

df_automated_ads <- df_findings %>% 
  rename(pattern_ = pattern) %>% 
  filter(!pattern_ %in% exclude) %>% # View()
  # filter(!str_detect(pattern_, include_doubleclick)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(pattern_, include_early_adds)) %>% 
  filter(!search_list %in% c("easylist_general_hide", "easylist_general_block", "easylist_general_hide_de")) %>% #View()
  mutate(year = year(crawl_date),
         trace = "Ad Server",
         sorting = 3,
         color = 1) %>% #View()
  select(year, trace, sorting, color) %>% 
  distinct() #%>%
```

```{r}
# preparing one df for all traces 
make_simple_trace_df <- function(df_, trace_, sorting_, color_){
  df_return <- df_ %>% 
    select(crawl_date) %>% 
    mutate(trace = trace_,
           sorting = sorting_,
           color = color_,
           year = year(crawl_date),
           month = month(crawl_date),
           simple_date = paste0(year,"-01-01") %>% ymd(.)) %>% 
    select(year, trace, sorting, color) %>% 
    distinct()
}


df_quality_channel <- make_simple_trace_df(df_site_tracker_vermarktung, "Quality Channel", 4, 2)
df_yahoo_iframe <- make_simple_trace_df(df_site_tracker_yahoo_iframe, "Yahoo", 5, 2)
df_iqd <- make_simple_trace_df(df_iqd_vermarktung, "IQ Digital", 6, 2)

# df_sitestat <- make_simple_trace_df(df_sitestat_2, "sitestat", 8, 5)
df_pay_1 <- make_simple_trace_df(df_site_tracker %>% filter(str_detect(embedded, "pcat")), "paid content", 7, 3)
df_pay_2 <- make_simple_trace_df(df_payed_, "paid content", 7, 3)
df_adblock <- make_simple_trace_df(df_adblock_dec, "Adblock-Block", 10, 5)
```
